title: Spend by day
description: telegram-spend.json and telegram-desk-spend.json (data folder root): USD per local day (YYYY-MM-DD, dayKey in src/usage/limit.ts), last 60 days. Plain Record<string, number>; written by addTelegramSpend in src/usage/spend.ts (addDeskSpend writes both files) as compact JSON with a final newline, atomicWrite, read-modify-write. telegram-spend.json: what turns Telegram started cost (front desk included); telegram-desk-spend.json: the front desk's share, checked against its daily cap. The reader drops keys that are not days and values that are not above 0. A map keyed by day, so no other keys.
